headline: Singapore October Factory Output Rises 6.1% on Strong AI Demand
summary: Singapore's manufacturing output increased by 6.1% in October, driven by robust demand for artificial intelligence, with gains posted across most industrial clusters.
why: Singapore serves as a major regional manufacturing and technology hub in Southeast Asia, providing key electronics and precision engineering inputs to global supply chains.

impacts.name: Straits Times Index
impacts.why: Stronger industrial production reflects robust economic activity and boosts listed manufacturing firms.
